declienting: Mapped bg-background-primary to the surface-raised semantic token.
Replaced the hard-coded *:duration-300 with the --duration-base token, so reduced motion is switched centrally rather than per component.

Fixed a latent defect carried over from the source: the variant order *:group-hover:scale-[1.05] emits no CSS in Tailwind v4, so the zoom never fired. Correct order is group-hover:*:scale-[1.05]. Verified in the browser — scale reads 1.05 on keyboard focus.
Dropped the data-component override prop; the hook is now fixed, which is what makes it a reliable test and analytics selector.
Kept verbatim: the group-hover and group-focus-visible scale pair and their motion-reduce counterparts — keyboard focus triggering the same zoom as hover is the part worth keeping.
